annotation.interpretation_a: The server can reject 0-RTT data if it cannot support *any* of the implied transport parameter values.
annotation.interpretation_b: The server can reject 0-RTT data if it cannot support *all* of the implied transport parameter values.
annotation.justification: The word 'cannot' is ambiguous. Does it mean 'none of' or 'not all of'? This affects how a server must evaluate the implied values and whether it rejects the 0-RTT data.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify whether the server must support all implied values or any of them. This affects implementation because a server might be able to support some, but not all, of the implied values.
